label: Continuous probability with zero point masses and variable interval masses
paraphrase: Lebesgue measure restricted to the closed unit interval is a probability on the real line, has zero mass on every singleton, and assigns the interval from zero to t its length for t between zero and one.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: A physically warranted continuous parameter measure, with its own geometry, for the parameters used in the fine-tuning comparison, then an independently warranted designer inference (unbuilt) and identification of the inferred witness with GOD_4.
connection_plan.blocker: This is a positive control: it shows that a measurable geometry, unlike cardinality, does supply a normalized probability with zero point masses on a continuum. It does not show that any physical parameter space carries this geometry or a warranted measure, and it derives no designer likelihood or designer.
